主要内容: Effex Management Solutions, a leading provider of staffing and contingent workforce management solutions, has been named part of the Houston Business Journal Fast 100 list for the second consecutive year. The Fast 100 list recognizes the fastest-growing Houston private companies, with Effex ranked based on two-year revenue growth between 2012 and 2014. The award ceremony took place at the Hilton Americas Hotel, where Effex CEO Louis Flory expressed pride in being recognized among Houston's elite businesses. Effex has experienced exponential growth, opening new offices in Michigan, Austin, and Arizona, and doubling its implementation team. The 2015 Fast 100 list includes companies from various industries, including healthcare, technology, manufacturing, and professional services. To qualify, companies must have been in business for at least five years, be headquartered in Houston, and earn at least $1 million in revenue for fiscal year 2014. Effex focuses on resolving inefficiencies in traditional staffing services for manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution markets through customized programs like Strategic Alliance and Flex Force.
